name: round-2645
title: Fix round #2645 (2026-10-31): locus, the figure doesn't jump, ellipse

cases.title: A given reshapes the triangle in place
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». On «AB = 5» the triangle on screen is reshaped, not replaced: C does not move. The same after each «הציגו תצורה אחרת».
cases.before: At about 1 configuration in 3, a different triangle replaced it (points moved up to 17).

cases.title: The first «הציגו תצורה אחרת» shows a different shape
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Press «הציגו תצורה אחרת» once: a triangle of a different shape.

cases.title: A sector is resized, not swapped
cases.lookFor: The sector keeps its shape and grows to radius 6.

cases.title: Naming an angle leaves the figure where it is
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». On the third line the triangle and M stay exactly where they were, and A1 is the angle drawn. «הציגו תצורה אחרת» still changes the figure, and A1 with it.
cases.before: The whole figure redrew on the third line.

cases.title: «AB = a» does not move the triangle
cases.lookFor: The triangle stays; a equals the drawn AB.

cases.title: An angle letter after a stated length moves nothing
A stated range still wins (regression guard)
cases.lookFor: The angle at B is under 30° in every configuration.

cases.title: A circle touching the ellipse at B and D
lines: B ו-D נקודות החיתוך של האליפסה עם ציר ה-y
המעגל משיק לאליפסה בנקודות B ו-D
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». The circle x²+y²=9 with M at (0,0), touching the ellipse at B and D.
cases.before: The last line was not understood.

cases.title: A circle inscribed in the ellipse
cases.lookFor: A circle of radius 3 centred at the origin, through (0,±3).

cases.title: The ellipse inscribed in a circle
cases.lookFor: A circle of radius 5 centred at the origin, through (±5,0).

cases.title: A circle tangent to the ellipse, touch point free
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». A circle touching the ellipse; «הציגו תצורה אחרת» moves where it touches.

cases.title: A circle tangent to a parabola
REFUSAL: two circles, so it asks which
cases.lookFor: The last line asks which circle; none is picked for the student.

cases.title: REFUSAL: the figure's circle is the wrong size
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused: a radius-4 circle cannot be inscribed in this ellipse.

cases.title: «היא עוברת דרך …» means the ellipse (book p1-8)
lines: נתונה אליפסה קנונית שהציר הגדול שלה על ציר ה-x
cases.lookFor: Start: press «נקה הכל». Every line records; the answer is x²/12 + y²/8 = 1.

cases.title: The major axis on the y-axis (book p2-11)
lines: נתונה אליפסה שהציר הגדול שלה הוא על ציר ה-y

cases.title: REFUSAL: «היא» with an ellipse and a parabola
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused, naming both curves.

cases.title: REFUSAL: two points in one line stay unread (one given per row)
cases.lookFor: The second line is not read.
